children: US President Donald Trump said he was banning CNN
and Politico from the White House, accusing outlets of repeatedly publishing what he called “FAKE NEWS” about his administration and the country.
In a Friday Truth Social post, Trump said the ban was effective immediately and suggested other media organizations could face similar action.

Trump also criticized Politico over what he described as an $8 million subscription from the US government under former President Joe Biden, calling the payment “illegal and ridiculous” and saying it appeared to him to be corruption.

“Media Outlets shouldn’t be able to constantly write or report FICTION and LIES when they’re covering the President of the United States, the Trump Administration, or the United States of America,” Trump wrote.
He did not provide further details in the post about how the ban would be implemented or what specific reports from the three outlets prompted the action.

as having recently changed its name from MSNBC, saying the change followed a lack of viewership and credibility. He concluded by saying other media outlets he considers “Fake News Media Outlets” could be targeted next.
The post did not provide additional information about the scope of the restrictions or how they would affect the outlets’ coverage of the White House.

title: Trump announces White House ban on CNN, MS NOW and Politico
